018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile;
019
020import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path;
021import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.HeapSize;
022import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.ClassSize;
023import org.apache.yetus.audience.InterfaceAudience;
024
025/**
026 * Cache Key for use with implementations of {@link BlockCache}
027 */
028@InterfaceAudience.Private
029public class BlockCacheKey implements HeapSize, java.io.Serializable {
030  private static final long serialVersionUID = -5199992013113130534L;
031  private final String hfileName;
032  private final long offset;
033  private BlockType blockType;
034  private final boolean isPrimaryReplicaBlock;
035
036  private Path filePath;
037
038  /**
039   * Construct a new BlockCacheKey
040   * @param hfileName The name of the HFile this block belongs to.
041   * @param offset    Offset of the block into the file
042   */
043  public BlockCacheKey(String hfileName, long offset) {
044    this(hfileName, offset, true, BlockType.DATA);
045  }
046
047  public BlockCacheKey(String hfileName, long offset, boolean isPrimaryReplica,
048    BlockType blockType) {
049    this.isPrimaryReplicaBlock = isPrimaryReplica;
050    this.hfileName = hfileName;
051    this.offset = offset;
052    this.blockType = blockType;
053  }
054
055  public BlockCacheKey(Path hfilePath, long offset, boolean isPrimaryReplica, BlockType blockType) {
056    this.filePath = hfilePath;
057    this.isPrimaryReplicaBlock = isPrimaryReplica;
058    this.hfileName = hfilePath.getName();
059    this.offset = offset;
060    this.blockType = blockType;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public int hashCode() {
065    return hfileName.hashCode() * 127 + (int) (offset ^ (offset >>> 32));
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  public boolean equals(Object o) {
070    if (o instanceof BlockCacheKey) {
071      BlockCacheKey k = (BlockCacheKey) o;
072      return offset == k.offset
073        && (hfileName == null ? k.hfileName == null : hfileName.equals(k.hfileName));
074    } else {
075      return false;
076    }
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public String toString() {
081    return this.hfileName + '_' + this.offset;
082  }
083
084  public static final long FIXED_OVERHEAD = ClassSize.estimateBase(BlockCacheKey.class, false);
085
086  /**
087   * Strings have two bytes per character due to default Java Unicode encoding (hence length times
088   * 2).
089   */
090  @Override
091  public long heapSize() {
092    return ClassSize.align(FIXED_OVERHEAD + ClassSize.STRING + 2 * hfileName.length());
093  }
094
095  // can't avoid this unfortunately
096  /** Returns The hfileName portion of this cache key */
097  public String getHfileName() {
098    return hfileName;
099  }
100
101  public boolean isPrimary() {
102    return isPrimaryReplicaBlock;
103  }
104
105  public long getOffset() {
106    return offset;
107  }
108
109  public BlockType getBlockType() {
110    return blockType;
111  }
112
113  public void setBlockType(BlockType blockType) {
114    this.blockType = blockType;
115  }
116
117  public Path getFilePath() {
118    return filePath;
119  }
120
121  public void setFilePath(Path filePath) {
122    this.filePath = filePath;
123  }
124
125}
